title: Delicious Poblano Tacos
description: A flavorful and spicy taco recipe with roasted poblano peppers and crispy tortillas. Serve with your favorite toppings.

ingredients.name: 1/4 cup shredded cheese (Monterey Jack or Cheddar)

instructions: Roast the poblano peppers on a baking sheet for 30-40 minutes, or until the skin is blistered and charred.
Remove the peppers from the oven and let them cool. Peel off the skin, remove the seeds, and chop the flesh into small pieces.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the tortillas for 30-60 seconds on each side, or until they're crispy and lightly browned.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the roasted poblano peppers onto a tortilla, followed by a spoonful of zesty Mexican salsa, some shredded cheese, and a sprinkle of chopped cilantro (if using).
